svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Programming languages: C, Java, Python. Generative AI & LLMs: Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA based), Working with LLMs. Frameworks: NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, LangChain, FastAPI, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Transformers, HuggingFace. Databases: MongoDB, MySQL, FAISS, Pinecone. Web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript. Tools & deployment: Git & GitHub, REST APIs, Vercel. Operating systems: Windows.
